notablePrerequisites:
Crab Umbra attached to Lightning-Rig Crew.
Lightning-Rig Crew does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Tap Lightning-Rig Crew to deal 1 damage to each opponent, creating 3 treasure tokens from Malcolm's trigger.
Sacrifice 3 treasure token for {2}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra to untap Lightning-Rig Crew.
Repeat.
